I posted a reply in #coastal-team asking for the night-dispatch contact's name. I haven't created the calendar event yet, because the name has to go in the notes.

I searched the brain and the channel, and I can't find that contact's name anywhere I can see. The coastal cheat sheet mentions that engineering gave the night dispatcher a manual CSV patch for the tide-table macro, but it doesn't name anyone.

Once you send the name in our DM, I'll book the 30-minute event for today, Monday 19 October, 15:00–15:30 Central, with you and Bettina, and put the name in the notes.
